h:
该工作流程可让您使用上一代中的任意数量的帧来扩展视频、裁剪和拼接（自动将裁剪后的图像调整为给定的视频大小，然后将其缩小），并在每次运行时向生成添加 1-4 个额外帧。

额外的帧数
您可以在此处选择 1-4 个额外帧。
加载图像：加载要用于该帧的图像。
插入帧#：选择要插入的帧。
显示帧（暂停）：选择超过 1 个将插入更多相同帧，即。在该帧上暂停此处选择的帧数。

加载模型
指定要使用的扩散模型、剪辑、VAE。
选择 LoRA。调整模型偏移。

FFLF
选择第一帧和最后一帧（您可以在橙色旁路节点中单独关闭它们）。
第一帧也用作参考图像，除非它被禁用。

针迹的主要输入
裁剪区域：选择要从图像中裁剪的区域。请注意，当您在此处选择一个框时，它的比例将被调整以匹配您选择的视频大小，因此如果它们的形状（宽/高比）不同，则裁剪将被强制调整大小。检查“带蒙版的裁剪预览”以查看覆盖在控制蒙版上的实际裁剪区域；确保蒙版也与裁剪区域相似，非白色的地方不会变得动画！当您使用裁剪时，您无法设置放大尺寸，因为它在完成生成后会缩放回初始裁剪尺寸。
额外帧：您可以在此处打开/关闭额外的额外帧。
选择高档模型和因子（后者仅与非裁剪和缝合工作流程相关）。

初始输入
原始图像文件夹：在此处输入您的输出文件夹。保存的帧将放置在这里，标记为正常和放大加上运行次数。
增量器：用于标识扩展视频的运行次数，最重要的是从上一个视频使用的控制帧来缝合扩展而不丢失运动。

旁路
请注意，对于初始的第一个视频，不应允许使用最后一个视频的控制帧，因为上次运行不会生成任何帧。这里另一个不太常见的事情是“使用缝合”，用于裁剪和缝合视频。

其他设置
控制数量：上次运行中要使用的最后帧的数量。这有助于保持运动，但由于这些帧将从视频中删除，因此会减少生成的帧数。
VACE控制强度：您可以在此处设置控制帧/遮罩的强度。
空白电平：设置空控制框的白电平。

拼接最终视频：
单独运行这个节点！
当您对您的一代进行扩展时，请在您的一代结束时启用此功能。
仅在生成所有需要的帧后才启用它，因为工作流程将从这里开始！
如果您只进行一次运行，预览最后一个视频节点就足够了。

o.en:
A workflow that lets you extend a video using any number of frames from the last generation, crop and stitch (automatically resize the cropped image to the given video size then scales it back), and add 1-4 extra frames per run to the generation.

Extra frames
You can select 1-4 extra frames here.
Load image: Load image to be used for this frame.
Insert into frame #: select which frame to insert into.
Display frame for (pause): Selecting more than 1 will insert more of the same frame, ie. pausing on that frame for the amount of frames selected here.

Load models
Specify the diffusion model, clip, VAE to be used.
Select LoRAs. Adjust model shift.

FFLF
Select first and last frame (you can turn them off separately in the orange bypasser nodes).
The first frame also serves as reference image, unless that's disabled.

Main input for stitch
Crop area: Select the area you want cropped from the image. Note that while you select a box here, it's ratio will be adjusted to match the video size you choose, so if they are not the same shape (W/H ratio), the crop will be forcefully resized. Check the "Crop preview with mask" to see the actual area of crop overlaid on the control mask; make sure the mask is also similar to the cropped area, the non-white places will NOT get animated! When you use cropping you can't set the upscale size, since it will be scaled back to the initial crop size after it's finished generating.
Extra frames: You can turn on/off the additional extra frames here.
Select upscale model and factor (latter is only relevant for non-crop-and-stitch workflows).

Initial inputs
Raw image folder: Type your output folder here. The saved frames will be placed here, labeled normal and upscaled plus the number of runs.
Incrementer: Used for indentifying the the number of runs for extending video, most importantly the control frames used from the last video to stitch the extension without losing motion.

Bypasses
Note that using control frames from last video should not be allowed for the initial, first video, as there will be no frames generated from last run. Another less common thing here is "Use stitch" which is used for the crop-and-stitch videos.

Misc settings
Number of Control: The number of last frames to be used from the previous run. This helps to keep motion, but as these frames will be cut from the video, will decrease the amount of frames generated.
VACE control strength: You can set the strength of contol frames / masks here.
Empty white level: set the white level of empty control frames.

Stitch final video:
Run this node alone, seperately!
Enable this at the end of your generation when you are making extensions to your generation.
Only enable it after you have all the frames needed generated already, since the workflow will start with this!
If you are only doing a single run, preview last video node should suffice.
